title: 第7章 洞天福地第8章 哪吒的邀请
content_zh:
前世看完西游故事后。
陆生就有一个疑问。
为何在这花果山会有这么一个洞天福地？
为何在这之前，竟没有一个妖精占领这福地？
要知道。
这时的猴群，还不是与十万天兵战斗时的猴妖大军。
顶多就是一群力气稍大、速度稍快的精怪猴子。
这样的猴群，竟能占领这么大的花果山？
不仅如此，还能够拥有一处洞天福地修炼！
这简直就是西游故事中的“桃花源记”
了！
陆生又不是傻子。
在看完老白猿有些拙劣的表演后。
他也已经明白。
这一切，都是西方佛门的算计！
想到这里。
陆生也不禁生出一股无力感。
西方佛门。
那是连天庭都没有办法的超级势力！
自己真能斗得过这样的“巨无霸”

吗？
至于为何要与西方佛门为敌……
原因也很简单。
陆生不能眼睁睁看着自己兄长被算计。
想到那个所谓的“斗战胜佛”
称号。
陆生再看了眼自己面前率性活泼的兄长。
他可以肯定，那绝不是自己兄长想要的。
“要做长远计划了啊……”
陆生唯一能够依仗的，便是“系统”
至于自己的系统，到底能否与西方佛门抗衡。
陆生并没有去思考这个问题。
在他看来，若是不成功。
大不了再“重开”
一次便是！
“老二，老二！”
content_en:
After reading the story of Journey to the West in my previous life.
Lu Sheng had a question.
Why is there such a paradise in Huaguo Mountain?
Why didn't a goblin occupy this blessed land before?
To know.
The monkey group at this time was not the army of monkey demons when they fought against hundreds of thousands of heavenly soldiers.
At most, they are just a group of slightly stronger and faster spirit monkeys.
How could such a group of monkeys occupy such a large Huaguo Mountain?
Not only that, you can also have a paradise to practice!
This is simply the "Peach Blossom Spring" in the Journey to the West story
Got it!
Lu Sheng is not a fool.
After watching the somewhat clumsy performance of the old white ape.
He also already understands.
All this is the plan of Western Buddhism!
Think of this.
Lu Sheng couldn't help but feel a sense of powerlessness.
Western Buddhism.
That's a super power that even heaven can't do anything about!
Can I really fight against such a "Big Mac"?
?
As for why we want to be enemies with Western Buddhism...
The reason is also very simple.
Lu Sheng couldn't just watch his brother being plotted against.
Thinking of the so-called "fighting and victorious Buddha"
title.
Lu Sheng glanced at the lively brother in front of him again.
He was certain that that was definitely not what his brother wanted.
"We need to make long-term plans..."
The only thing Lu Sheng can rely on is the "system"
As for whether my own system can compete with Western Buddhism.
Lu Sheng did not think about this problem.
In his opinion, if it fails.
The worst case scenario is that we will “reopen” again.
Just once!
"Second dick, dick!"
